## Baseline Python environment

`baselines/pyscfabsim/requirements.txt` pins the baseline's own
environment (PyTorch, Gymnasium, wandb and friends). It is not
redistributed from this repository -- a fresh clone builds it with `pip
install -r`. Consult that file and each package's own licence if you
ship a prebuilt baseline image.
